author: Spetz
text:
Hi there Les_Paul,

Great work you have made here.. Congrats, you truly deserve the appreciation from us all!

I've recently joined this community and have only been studying the
content so far, want to get a better understanding of how you guys work
here. So I've just spent some time today to start learning more about
the FTR concept, could you give me an insight of what I have labeled in
the chart? Is it correct?

The thought process now should be (correct me if I'm wrong please):
Looking to buy at the nearest bull FTR (if not long already), then, if
bear FTR holds and price drops and breaks the previous bull FTR, I
should look for bear FTR's formations.. If price rallies and breaks the
bear FTR, I should continue to buy (again, if not already long) at the
bull FTR's that appear in the way up.

This is not considering the HTF importance, just plain and simple chart thought process for our education.

Thanks in advance.

Best regards,

James Correia
